title: A magnificent performance 🙏🙏🙏🙏🙏
text: We are totally thrilled with the show and would attend it again anytime. It was a magnificent experience. We had booked premium seats and sat in the front row.
author: 365kerstinr

title: Great Evening
text: Very entertaining show in an intimate theatre. The show lasts about an hour so perfect for pre-dinner entertainment.
author: Nicole_P

title: Fun intro to flamenco
text:
With no previous flamenco experience, we found this high fun, passionate and energised performance a joy to experience. Felt authentic

Set in the small theatre below a flameco training school. The stage was raised which meant excellent views all round

We opted for row 2 which was close to the action and had excellent view. Comfortable enough seats 

Performance was an hour and featured very energetic dancing, incredible Spanish guitar and some singing sections
author: UKhattrick

title: Superb
text:
Superb! We  loved this; possibly THE highlight of our entire trip to Seville. A very interesting experience as first time flamenco viewers and the dancing and whole performance by the musicians and singers, too, was enthralling.
We paid the extra three euros to sit in the first three rows but that isn’t necessary. The whole audience would have a good view.
author: H3747AGcarolinep

title: Great experience
text: Really passionate show - I went in worried it would be a well oiled tourist machine, but the dancers danced with a lot of passion and conviction. A great experience.
author: samuell239

title: I really recommend it
text: Awesome show, I recommend the venue, very simple experience to pick up the tickets.
author: Depassage91

title: Theater performance much better than a dinner performance.
text: We were party of four and very impressed with the performers and the show.  The theater was well air-conditioned and comfortable.  We’ve seen other performances at a dinner setting, but believe the theater setting is more appropriate and easy to see from a stage.  Congratulations to the dancers and the production well done.
author: Rudy_T

title: Couples visit to flamenco
text: Very professional and enjoyable one hours experience.  I would recommend when in Seville.  Nice walk to get there by the river
author: Dorothy01smith

title: 100% recommended
text:
100% recommended show.
The dancer conveys passion.
It would be nice to be able to choose, though, the row and seat according to the ticket type.
author: I2727EHmar_ar

title: Excellent flamenco experience
text: Venue was intimate, seating was comfortable. Dancing, singing and guitar were all amazing. Something that could have enhanced the experience would have been a 5 minute or so introduction to flamenco dancing, what to look for, its history, etc.
author: G5907POlindaf
